stories.title: 'I want to build dynasties here': How the Valkyries built a title winner in just two years
stories.summary: When Golden State joined the WNBA, the owner said the team would win a title within five years. The Valkyries did it in two.

stories.title: Led by MVP Williams, Valkyries outlast Dream, secure first WNBA title
stories.summary: Gabby Williams scored 30 points and was named Finals MVP, after leading the Golden State Valkyries to their first WNBA title with a 68-63 Game 7 victory over the Atlanta Dream on Saturday night at the Chase Center in San Francisco.

stories.title: Embattled Riley relishes win as USC saves CFP hopes with upset of Ohio State
stories.summary: USC kept its CFP hopes alive in a 30-18 upset of No. 2 Ohio State as head coach Lincoln Riley delivered an emphatic victory amid questions surrounding his future.

stories.title: Sources: Saquon won't be traded before deadline despite Eagles' struggles
stories.summary: Saquon Barkley will not be traded before the trade deadline, sources told NFL Network, putting an end to speculation that the Eagles RB could be on the move.

stories.title: Sources: Raiders not planning Crosby trade as star DE wants to stay with Vegas
stories.summary: The Raiders do not plan on trading Maxx Crosby, who wants to stay in Las Vegas, sources told ESPN.
